text.title: A Class Project on Recycling
body: Every Thursday afternoon, Mr Amrani's class works on a special project about recycling.
Last week, the students visited a recycling centre near their school.
They watched how workers separated plastic, paper and glass into different containers.
One worker explained that recycling one tonne of paper saves several trees.
The students were surprised to learn this fact.
After the visit, they decided to put three coloured bins in their classroom.
Now, every student throws rubbish into the correct bin.
Nawal, the class leader, checks the bins every day and writes a short report.
She says the project has changed the way her classmates think about waste.
Next month, the school will organise a bigger cleaning day for the whole neighbourhood.
Nawal hopes that other classes will join them too.
